description: Unit tests for NSSCertDatabaseChromeOS, testing certificate import, trust settings, module listing, and system slot interactions within Chromium's network security code.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabaseChromeOSTest
classes.description: Test fixture for NSSCertDatabaseChromeOS, setting up user slots and observing database changes.

methods.name: ListModules
methods.description: Tests that each user's module list includes their own slot and excludes others.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Tests importing CA certificates to correct user slots and verifying their presence.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Tests importing server certificates and verifying correct association.

methods.name: NoCrashIfShutdownBeforeDoneOnWorkerPool
methods.description: Ensures no crash occurs if database is deleted during ListCerts processing.

methods.name: ListCertsReadsSystemSlot
methods.description: Verifies listing certificates reads from the system slot.

methods.name: ListCertsDoesNotCrossReadSystemSlot
methods.description: Ensures listing certs does not read from system slot when using a different slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustCertIsAlreadyOnPublicSlot
methods.description: Tests modifying trust for a cert already on the public slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustCertIsOnlyOnOtherSlot
methods.description: Tests trust modification for a cert only on a different slot, verifying it moves to public slot.

methods.name: SetCertTrustPublicSlotIsSystemSlot
methods.description: Tests behavior when public slot is the system slot, expecting trust change to fail.
